author: wyliemason1614
body:
So here I am again begging for an appeal. It has been about 10 months since i got banned from Avicus. I was wondering if the staff would look into some way to allow me to play on your server again.  I am very sorry about what I did and I really hope that I can find another chance on this server.


 Regards, 
            Mason
